content.title: FDA removes hold on vTv’s cadisegliatin clinical programme for diabetes
content.summary: Last July, the agency placed a hold on the trial due to a chromatographic signal detected in a human ADME study of the therapy.

thumbnail.caption: The therapy is being examined as a potential oral adjunctive treatment to insulin for type 1 diabetes. Credit: ANDREI ASKIRKA/Shutterstock.
